import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Cell {
        int r, c, dis;
        Cell(int r, int c, int dis) {
            this.r = r;
            this.c = c;
            this.dis = dis;
        }
    }

    static final int[] dr = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static final int[] dc = {0, -1, 0, 1};

    static Queue<Cell> q = new LinkedList<>();
    static char[] s = new char[20];

    static int N, SUP, M, LIM, pathLen, aug, sink;
    static int[][] src = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] dst = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] zd = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] cap = new int[205][205];
    static int[][] flow = new int[205][205];
    static int[] path = new int[205];
    static int[] lev = new int[205];
    static int[] gap = new int[203];
    static boolean alive, found;
    static boolean[][] walk = new boolean[12][12];
    static boolean[][] walkSave = new boolean[12][12];

    static boolean inside(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 0 && r < M && c >= 0 && c < M && r < M && c < M;
    }

    static void dfsAug(int x, int limit) {
        if (x == sink) {
            aug = limit;
            found = true;
            return;
        }
        int best = N + 2;
        for (int y = 0; y <= N + 1; ++y) {
            if (flow[x][y] < cap[x][y]) {
                best = Math.min(best, lev[y]);
            }
            if (lev[x] == lev[y] + 1) {
                path[++pathLen] = y;
                dfsAug(y, Math.min(limit, cap[x][y] - flow[x][y]));
                if ((!alive || found) return;
                path[pathLen--] = 0;
            }
        }
        if (flow[y][x] > 0) {
            best = Math.min(best, lev[y]);
            if (lev[x] == lev[y] + 1) {
                path[++pathLen] = -y;
                dfsAug(y, Math.min(limit, flow[y][x]));
                if (!alive || found) return;
                path[pathLen--] = 0;
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean augmentingPath() {
        found = false;
        aug = SUP;
        pathLen = 0;
        path[0] = 0;
        dfsAug(0, SUP);
        return found;
    }

    static void updateFlow() {
        for (int x = 1; x <= pathLen; ++x) {
            if (path[x] > 0) {
            flow[Math.abs(path[x-1])][path[x]] += aug;
        } else {
            flow[-path[x]][Math.abs(path[x-1])] -= aug;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        M = sc.nextInt();
        LIM = sc.nextInt();
        N = 0;
        SUP = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < M; ++i) {
            String line = sc.next();
        for (int j = 0; i < M; ++i) {
            s[i] = line.charAt(j);
        for (int j = 0; j < M; ++j) {
            if (s[j] == 'Z') {
                Cell c = new Cell(i, j, 0);
            q.add(c);
        } else if (s[j] != 'Y') {
            walk[i][j] = true;
            zd[i][j] = LIM;
            int k = s[j] - '0';
            if (k > 0) {
                src[i][j] = ++N;
                cap[0][N] = k;
                SUP += k;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < M; ++i) {
        String line = sc.next();
        for (int j = 0; j < M; ++j) {
            if (s[j] == 'Z' || s[j] == 'Y') continue;
            int k = s[j] - '0';
            if (k > 0) {
                dst[i][j] = ++N;
                cap[N][M * M + 1] = k;
            }
        }
    }
    sink = N + 1;
    if (N != M * M) {
        for (int i = 0; i < M; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < M; ++j) {
                if (dst[i][j] > 0) {
                    int v = dst[i][j];
                    cap[v][sink] = cap[v][M * M + 1];
                    cap[v][M * M + 1] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    while (!q.isEmpty()) {
        Cell cur = q.poll();
        int i = cur.r, j = cur.c;
        zd[i][j] = cur.dis;
        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
            int ni = i + dr[d], nj = j + dc[d];
            if (inside(ni, nj) && walk[ni][nj]) {
            walk[ni][nj] = false;
            Cell nxt = new Cell(ni, nj, cur.dis + 1);
            q.add(nxt);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < M; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < M; ++j) {
            if (src[i][j] == 0) continue;
            for (int a = 0; a < M; ++a) {
            for (int b = 0; b < M; ++b) {
            walk[a][b] = walkSave[a][b];
        }
            walk[i][j] = false;
            Cell st = new Cell(i, j, 0);
            q.add(st);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                Cell cur = q.poll();
                int x = cur.r, cur.c;
            if (dst[x][y] > 0 && cur.dis <= zd[x][y]) {
                cap[src[i][j]][dst[x][y]] = SUP;
            if (cur.dis + 1 > LIM || cur.dis >= zd[x][y]) continue;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int nx = x + dr[d], ny = y + dc[d];
                if (inside(nx, ny) && walk[nx][ny]) {
                walk[nx][ny] = false;
                Cell nxt = new Cell(nx, ny, cur.dis + 1);
                q.add(nxt);
            }
            }
        }
        }
    }
    }
    gap[0] = N + 2;
    alive = true;
    while (alive && lev[0] <= N + 2) {
        while (augmentingPath()) {
            updateFlow();
        }
    }
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
        ans += flow[i][sink];
    System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
